landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable wifi and the same hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak mobile signal or no signal at all. HatchGrab was built precisely for that.
landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers cannot choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, on the tablet at the counter, on the laptop in the van — and on the POS terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in the dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp messages get answered while you are on the way to the trading spot or at the grill, with your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram are coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp messages will get answered while you are on the way to the trading spot or at the grill. Messenger and Instagram come next.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online orders are paused automatically, so customers do not send orders you will not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose the collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.steps.title: Set everything up and start taking orders in about 15 minutes.
landing.steps.lede: Three things to sort out — and for two of them a photo is enough.
landing.steps.menuBody: Photograph your menu board or paste in the text. Items, prices and extras come across by themselves. You just check they are correct.
landing.steps.scheduleBody: Have it on your website? We will read it from there and keep it up to date. If not, photograph that too. You just approve what it finds.
landing.steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR code on the van. Orders arrive on your screen, in the order you need to cook them.
landing.testimonial.quote: HatchGrab has made ordering much easier. Everything is organised, we track stock and know exactly how many pizzas we have left to sell — and the time slots are fantastic for busy villages.
landing.pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade your plan when you need to.
landing.pricing.switchBody: See how much you would pay with HatchGrab for the same orders. Takes about a minute.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.metaDescription: Clear answers for food truck owners: HatchGrab’s prices, setup, taking orders and payments by card or at collection.
landing.final.title: Want to see how easy setup is?
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or a screenshot of your menu and we will turn it into a working ordering page, for you to try in under 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No sign-up, no card, nothing to install. Have a look, then decide.

featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck, with payment on your own POS terminal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — that show the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins, with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders are paused, so customers do not send orders you will not see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into meal deals and offer add-on suggestions at checkout, so the average order value goes up.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as “Sold out” with one tap — customers see it greyed out straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set the stock quantity and it goes down with every incoming order, then the item is automatically marked “Sold out”.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign the order a buzzer number when you hand out the buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as those for food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs you and see what you really made at every event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, taxes and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, with no need for a separate POS terminal.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, with order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that must be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, spreading demand across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a slot fills up, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private ordering link and their own QR code.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one takes you straight to its own ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm it.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically reply to WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Notify customers automatically by SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.

aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab creates practical software for food trucks and catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.title: Built around the way food trucks really work
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I created Village Foodie, a listing that helps people discover the food trucks coming to their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks move constantly, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software offered to them is built for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering providers, to help them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing and lose less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools built around the way these businesses really operate.
